H1.statement: Real sentences minimize dependency length vs. random projective linearization, on both metrics.
H1.role: sanity check -- failure indicates a broken pipeline, not a refuted theory
H1.baseline_note: B2_arity_preserving is reported but not scored: it preserves each node's left/right dependent counts, so it often reproduces the real order exactly and cannot detect a DLM effect.

H2.statement: The head-based metric shows a larger real-vs-random effect than the word-based metric.

H3.statement: Word-based dependency length is derivative of head-based dependency length.
H3.predicted_direction: >=50% shrinkage in |beta(word_DL)| when head_DL is added, with beta(head_DL) significant
